id: \rHave you been to the tower? I try to avoid it.
en: \rHave you been to the tower? I try to avoid it.
it: \rSei stato alla torre? Io cerco di evitarla.

id: \bShould I get a Fighting-type? My sister says it would suit me.
en: \bShould I get a Fighting-type? My sister says it would suit me.
it: \bDovrei prendere un tipo Lotta? Mia sorella dice che mi si addice.

id: \bWhat a nice day it is. Remember to keep training.
en: \bWhat a nice day it is. Remember to keep training.
it: \bChe bella giornata. Ricordati di continuare ad allenarti.

id: \bI'm waiting for a match in the World Coronation Series.
en: \bI'm waiting for a match in the World Coronation Series.
it: \bSto aspettando un incontro del World Coronation Series.

id: \bA match at last. Bring it on.
en: \bA match at last. Bring it on.

id: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 381.
en: Rotom Phone: Based on performance, your rank is now 381.
it: Smart Rotom: In base ai risultati, la tua posizione in classifica è ora 381.

id: \bYour battle style. I need to experience it myself.
en: \bYour battle style. I need to experience it myself.
it: \bIl tuo stile di lotta. Devo provarlo di persona.

id: \bNot bad, but you have a way to go before becoming synced with your Pokémon.
en: \bNot bad, but you have a way to go before becoming synced with your Pokémon.
it: \bNon male, ma hai ancora strada da fare prima di entrare in sintonia con i tuoi Pokémon.

id: \bWe'll battle again once I reach the Great Class. Until then.
en: \bWe'll battle again once I reach the Great Class. Until then.
it: \bLotteremo di nuovo quando avrò raggiunto la Classe Super. Alla prossima.

id: Incoming call from Professor Cerise: \PN, could you come back to the lab? I have a new job for you.
en: Incoming call from Professor Cerise: \PN, could you come back to the lab? I have a new job for you.
it: Chiamata in arrivo dalla Professoressa Cerise: \PN, potresti tornare al laboratorio? Ho un nuovo incarico per te.

id: \bI used to study under Professor Cerise.
en: \bI used to study under Professor Cerise.
it: \bUn tempo studiavo sotto la guida della Professoressa Cerise.
